Recovery Workbench Volume and Scale Forecast v4
Next version of 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Volume and Scale Forecast v3.xlsx. Decision D-RCV-60 (adopt Architecture v5 and realign the documents and stories).
Every figure, ID, unit and date of v3 is kept. The realignment adds the per-service volumes, topics and queues, and changes five cells whose wording was written for one monolith.
Change log
v4, 22 November 2026, D-RCV-60 microservice realignment, T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash
What changed in v4

Service volumes (new sheet): 19 rows, one per owning service, each with its driver, the 2027 volume, the unit, the basis cell in this workbook, its topic, its task queue and its consumers. No driver is shared, so the totals on Inputs, Monthly, Five years and Route activity do not move (CG-B-DATA-26-1; ASM-B-DATA-26-1).

Topics and queues (new sheet): the 19 service topics plus the shared rwb.decision-record.v1 with partitions, replication, retention, record key, consumer groups, retry and dead letter; then the 19 task queues with their workflows, activities, Schedules and scale note; then the platform settings (CG-B-DATA-26-4; ASM-B-DATA-26-4).
Read path!A2: only rwb-source-data holds the grant on the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views; every other service asks P1 (CG-B-DATA-26-2; ASM-B-DATA-26-2).

Read path!C15: the lake refresh is gone; the three Workbench jobs are case creation and allocation (JOB-02, JOB-03), reconciliation (JOB-04) and the WIN notice file (JOB-10), each a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow in its own service (CG-B-DATA-26-3; ASM-B-DATA-26-3).
Read path!C16 and Inputs!G7: the freshness stamp and the v_ace_account read are named against rwb-source-data (CG-B-DATA-26-2; ASM-B-DATA-26-2).
Key!C10: a view read is a SELECT by rwb-source-data on behalf of a screen or a workflow, not a read by the Workbench or by a lake refresh (CG-B-DATA-26-2; ASM-B-DATA-26-2).
What did not change
Inputs: 34 rows, I01 to I34, with every value, unit, kind, source and effect unchanged.
Monthly (14 months), Five years (2027 to 2031), Users and load, ACE growth (the 14 tables and 12 columns), Route activity and Key: every formula, figure and label unchanged.

The 14 new ACE tables and 12 columns of ACE growth, the account inventory on Inputs (I01 to I07), the 173,807 restructure accounts (I26) and the document storage on Five years keep the values v3 carries.

The source holds no release date, so no date is marked (tentative) and no date is raised as a gap: the dates in the workbook are bank data dates (30 June 2026, 6 July 2026, the July 2025 to June 2026 averages) and they are copied unchanged.
